jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer Position for Xsolla's Smart Wallet in Web3
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer who has tested real on-chain products — the contracts and the transactions, not only the web app in front of them. You will own quality for Xsolla's smart wallet on Xsolla ZK, our Ethereum-compatible ZK rollup: the wallet players use to hold, receive and send tokens and in-game items, signing in with the account they already have. The work runs on both sides of the chain. On the backend, you will confirm that a wallet address pre-computed from a salt is the address that actually gets deployed. On the frontend, you will follow a signed operation from the client's RPC call through the bundler to finality, and prove it landed, failed or reverted the way it should. You will fork the chain to test against real state, deploy and call contracts from the command line, and turn what you learn into automated suites. You will work in a small, senior engineering team alongside an external wallet-infrastructure partner. You can tell a defect in our code from one in a partner SDK or in the chain itself — and you bring the evidence to show which. AI coding tools are part of how you work every day, and you set them up so the rest of the team gets the same leverage.

jobs.description_text: The Work The Manager, Model Validation reports to the Director, Model Risk Management and supports the delivery of model validation activities across the Bank. The role executes validation procedures, contributes to validation strategies, and supports the effective management of model risk in accordance with the Bank's Model Risk Management Framework and applicable regulatory requirements. The scope includes models used for credit and treasury risk management, including AIRB and IFRS 9 ECL, interest rate risk, liquidity risk, and stress testing approaches used to support ICAAP. The role works closely with model risk stakeholders and conducts detailed reviews of model methodologies, assumptions, intended use, limitations, inputs, implementation, and performance. Responsibilities include completing benchmark and outcome analyses, documenting issues and recommendations, drawing evidence-based conclusions, and preparing model validation reports in accordance with the Bank's Model Risk Management Framework (MRMF). The primary focus is the execution of model validation activities, with additional support provided for model governance activities such as regulatory self-assessments, annual attestations, and risk reporting.

jobs.description_text: Purpose of Job As part of a growing and dynamic Commercial Portfolio Management team, the Senior Commercial Account Manager is responsible for the day-to-day management of an assigned group of lending partners and associated portfolio of mortgages, from funding through maturity. The Senior Account Manager’s portfolio will be comprised of complex construction, renovation, and portfolio mortgages secured by all asset classes and ranging in size from $5.0 million to $50.0 million. Participation in syndicated transactions of $150.0 million or more can also be expected. The Senior Account Manager will deliver superior customer service by understanding, and responding to, the needs of the client by way of underwriting renewals, assumptions, refinances, loan modifications, etc. in an effort to meet annual retention targets. Work product must adhere to established policies and underwriting standards and meet compliance and control requirements.

Another key aspect of the role is to assist in the determination of where Equitable may be exposed to credit or other key risks and identify possible mitigating strategies and/or actions that can be implemented to minimize or eliminate the risk. Developing internal relationships with credit stakeholders is critical to the role.

jobs.description_text: The Senior Technical Program Manager (STPM) reports to the Director, Technical Program Management. The STPM owns end-to-end plan management and delivery execution for highly complex technical programs across EQ Bank's Digital Banking ecosystem, with a strong emphasis on measurable business value, customer outcomes, reliability, and usability. The STPM leads execution across multiple interdependent teams and domains, proactively surfaces technical and non-technical risks, establishes mitigation plans, manages complex dependencies, drives decisions, and enables alignment across Engineering, Product, Business, Enterprise partners, and third parties. The STPM operates effectively where scope, ownership, or the delivery path is ambiguous. The role is expected to build strong cross-functional relationships, influence senior stakeholders without authority, resolve escalated delivery constraints, and provide clear executive-level visibility of program health, trade-offs, and decisions.

The specialist will contribute to the development of policies, processes, and procedures for Infrastructure & Operations (I&O) and provide expert advice on technology utilization to enhance overall enterprise value. In addition to these responsibilities, the position will focus on creating robust network architectures and developing high-level designs that meet business requirements. This includes designing network topologies, selecting appropriate technologies, and producing detailed documentation. The specialist will collaborate with various teams, including Azure Cloud Operations and business unit infrastructure requirements, to ensure alignment with organizational objectives while supporting high-level infrastructure needs across the enterprise.

jobs.description_text: Purpose of the Job The Vice President, Enterprise Risk Management is a senior member of the CRO’s leadership team and serves as the CRO and Deputy CRO’s primary partner on enterprise risk governance, leading the second-line ERM function and the continued development and operation of a forward-looking risk management program aligned with regulatory expectations and commensurate with EQ Bank’s size, scope and complexity. The VP, ERM will provide the vision and roadmap to further embed ERM across the organization, working closely with business leaders to strengthen risk management capabilities while providing independent oversight and effective challenge on strategic and business decisions. The role will oversee the Bank’s enterprise-wide view of risk, including its Board-approved Risk Appetite Framework, management and reporting of key risks, and reporting to the Board and Enterprise Risk Management Committee (ERMC), while supporting the CRO and Deputy CRO in interactions with OSFI and other regulatory stakeholders. The VP, ERM will also lead the risk management aspects of integration of PC Financial with EQ Bank and build a high-performing ERM team that is nimble and innovative, enabling EQ Bank to achieve its strategic objectives while operating within its risk appetite.

The team owns the open source library end to end, including: - The streaming execution engine, including scheduling, backpressure, and resource management across CPUs and GPUs - Batch inference for LLMs and multimodal models, including integrations with inference engines such as vLLM - Data loading for production training workloads with Ray Train and popular ML frameworks - Connectors for data sources and formats such as Parquet, Iceberg, Delta Lake, Lance, and cloud object storage - Performance, stability, and fault tolerance at large scale This is a first-line engineering management role where you'll lead a team of engineers, stay involved in technical design and code, and own the team's roadmap within the open source project. Ray Data has a large and active community, so you'll also work closely with external contributors to review designs, guide technical direction, and support the project's continued growth and success. jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE Anyscale’s product security needs are growing as we ship to larger and more demanding customers. We’re looking for a Senior Product Security Engineer to own our secure software development lifecycle and to be engineering’s partner on building security into the product. Reporting to the Head of Security, you will work in close partnership with engineering. This is a senior, high-ownership role. You will own and operate a scalable SSDL, partner with engineering on security features and secure design, review the security of existing systems and new initiatives, and own how we find, track, drive to resolution and report on vulnerabilities in what we ship. This is a product security role with platform depth, not a cloud security role. This role is based in India. jobs.title: Test Automation Engineer
jobs.description_text: Test Automation Engineer Almere | 32-40 uur per week Over de functie Onze software verwerkt jaarlijks 35 miljoen declaraties voor zorgaanbieders door heel Nederland. Als Test Automation Engineer ben jij diegene die ervoor zorgt dat onze software blijft werken zoals het hoort: betrouwbaar, snel en veilig. jobs.title: Front End Developer
jobs.description_text: Front-end Softwareontwikkelaar - Bouw mee aan de toekomst van mondzorgsoftware! Locatie: Heemstede Salaris: €4.000 – €5.500 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur) Dienstverband: Vast, minimaal 32 uur per week Ben jij een ervaren softwareontwikkelaar die graag impact maakt? Wil je werken aan innovatieve applicaties die de mondzorgsector vooruithelpen? Bij Vertimart zoeken we een Front-end specialist met een passie voor C# en Blazor . Jij brengt onze software naar een hoger niveau en zorgt voor efficiënte, gebruiksvriendelijke oplossingen. Jij speelt een sleutelrol in het ontwikkelen en verbeteren van onze applicaties: - Ontwikkelen & optimaliseren – Bouw en verfijn software met C# en Blazor. - Nieuwe functionaliteiten creëren – Werk aan innovatieve features en modules. - Technische uitdagingen tackelen – Los bugs en complexe vraagstukken op. - Samenwerken & kennis delen – Werk intensief samen met collega’s en deel best practices. - Processen verbeteren – Denk mee over efficiëntere software- en ontwikkelprocessen. Jouw profiel - Sterke technische skills – C# en .NET kennen geen geheimen voor je. Blazor en Azure-ervaring zijn een plus. - Analytisch & resultaatgericht – Jij vertaalt complexe processen naar slimme oplossingen. - Goede communicatie – Je schakelt makkelijk met zowel tech- als non-tech collega’s. - Gestructureerd & nauwkeurig – Je hebt oog voor detail en werkt kwaliteitsgericht.
